evidence_excerpts: Φ is the amount of effective information that can be exchanged across the minimum information bipartition of a complex.
The minimum information bipartition MIB(S) is the bipartition for which the normalized effective information reaches a minimum, and the corresponding value is Φ(S).
text: The quantity of consciousness available to a system is measured by the Φ value of a complex, where Φ is effective information across the minimum information bipartition.
